responsibility: Implements the GCN offload image builder used by GCC’s offloading pipeline. It drives a secondary compilation of device code, post-processes the generated GCN assembly, assembles and links it into an HSA code object, extracts or preserves relevant ELF/debug information, and emits a host C source file that embeds the resulting device image for later registration by the host program; along the way it manages temporary files, tool invocation arguments, environment sanitation, ABI/architecture flags such as xnack and SRAM-ECC, and conversion of the final hsaco/object contents into the form consumed by the native host compilation step.
